title: P01 closes 21 registered source gaps on printed pages 5–9 without adding shared semantics
research_question: Can the registered P01 source gaps on printed pages 5–9 be closed through source-first supplements while preserving time scope, conditional branches and the boundary between reusable rules and case-only support?
before_state: The P01 Life source-gap ledger contained 21 registered gaps from prior source-readjudication summaries, with a risk of duplicating already covered rules or narrowing source time expressions into an unsupported single layer.
result: The accepted P01 supplement closes all 21 registered gap IDs: 20 are closed by new source-first supplement records and GAP-021 is confirmed already covered by canonical P02-200. It adds 77 atomic supplemental records (64 reusable structural/state/timing/constraint records and 13 CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY records). Cumulative P01 canonical records after merge are 277, comprising 213 reusable projection rules and 64 case-support-only records. The summary reports no new shared semantic primitive, memory type, independent time scale, numeric weight, probability or decay.
key_insights: Source gap IDs may bundle multiple independent source relations; the supplement atomizes pivots and conditional branches rather than forcing one record per gap.
The source's time expressions are preserved: explicit 大限/流年 dual-layer wording remains dual-layer, while generic 人生枢纽/命运枢纽 is not silently narrowed to 大限.
Condition-gated star-system branches remain distinct; for example, 武杀 本宫见煞忌 and 本宫外见煞忌 are not collapsed into a single valence score.
The existing P02-200 coverage for GAP-021 is reused instead of duplicated.
Case-specific historical claims remain CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY rather than being promoted to reusable canonical rules.
negative_findings: 13 of the 77 supplemental records are CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY, not reusable projection rules.
No new shared semantic primitive, memory type, independent time scale, numeric weight, probability or decay was introduced.
The supplement resolves the 21 registered gap IDs; it does not claim every possible claim on printed pp5-9 has been independently re-extracted beyond those registered gaps.
unexpected_findings: One registered P01 gap was already covered by canonical P02-200, so the correct action was to close the gap reference without creating duplicate rule content.

boundaries.source_status: The accepted source-gap summary, closure ledger and time-scope artifact are explicit on main.
boundaries.implementation_status: 77 supplemental records are accepted in the Knowledge lane; this does not close the entire P01 corpus or authorize Product runtime changes.
boundaries.internal_fidelity: Merged PR #577 reports final-head full pytest, syntax, P0 audit and governance validation passed; this Sidecar task did not rerun those checks.
